name: settings-layout
title: Settings Layout
description: The two-pane Settings frame — a 220px sticky section nav with current-page marking and counts, and one 960px content column where forms cap at 720px left-aligned and lists fill; on a phone the nav is the first screen and pages push in with a back link.

meta.whenToUse: An app's Settings area — many settings pages browsed sideways, each starting at the same x with one width rule.
meta.whenNotToUse: One settings form on its own page (AppShellPage size="prose"), or a record's tabs (Tabs).
